All tools/Image Resizer

Image Resizer

Find the perfect fit for your next image.

PNG is lossless; the quality slider does not change its compression. Try WebP or JPEG for smaller files. JPEG uses a white background for transparency.

Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

How to use this tool

  1. Choose your image (up to 20 MB).
  2. Enter width and height; keep the aspect ratio to avoid stretching.
  3. Create a preview and download the resized image.

Good to know

Can I enlarge an image?

Yes, but enlarging does not restore detail. Outputs are limited to 25 million pixels and 10,000 pixels per side. Animated images and SVG are not supported.

Are my files or text uploaded?

Processing happens in your browser. Toolora does not send your files or text to a server. Close the page to clear the tool session.
